_comment: Shared camera framing and detector config, read by main.py and detector.py. Checked into git deliberately - these are not secrets, and losing git-blame history on coordinate changes was worse than the alternative. Baked into the image: changes need a rebuild. prudynt.json's motion ROI on the camera itself is a separate system and is NOT read from here - it has to be updated by hand over SSH when this changes.
_motion_roi_note: Firmware ciao+b16d546 (2026-10-04) watches motion on the 768x432 substream, so the camera's prudynt.json now holds this box scaled x0.4: roi 160,240 -> 640,330. Firmware ignores the left edge (timestamp burn-in exclusion bug) and actually watches x 8-639. Sensitivity 2, cooldown 30 s.

detector._comment: MegaDetector worker (detector.py; DEFAULTS there explain each value). count_threshold: a detection at or above this counts as a bird and gets its own AIY name. Raise torch_threads to speed up, lower to leave the NAS more headroom.
